name: formula_ace_v1
source: ACE offline (+GT & noGT runs) first-attempt generator answers on TRAIN items, generated WITH the learned playbook; correct only
target: full ACE JSON answer (reasoning, bullet_ids citing playbook bullets, final_answer)
note: BUGGY: targets cite playbook bullet ids absent from the input -> adapter hallucinates endless id lists (superseded by v2)
recipe: LoRA r=16 alpha=32 dropout=0.05 on q,k,v,o,gate,up,down (134M params, 0.41%); lr 1e-4 cosine, 5% warmup; ~32k tokens/step; 2 epochs; 5% of rows held out (seed 42) for dev loss; loss on assistant tokens only; Qwen3-32B (YaRN x4 config), bf16
